*The health gain happens once per second when moving.

* This skill only activates if you receive at least 1 XP from a foe death.

* Skills that require a morale boost, such as Resurrection Signet, Sunspear Rebirth Signet, and Celestial skills, are not recharged by "Is There Anything I Can't Do?".
* Experience scrolls stack with "Kneel Before Your Master".

Unlike other skills without an activation time, this skill has the standard aftercast delay of 0.75 second and cannot be used while moving or activating another skill.

*This skill mimics the effect of the Guild Lord's Amulet of Protection.
*Under Angelic Protection, you take the damage first and then are healed. If you take more damage than you have health remaining, you will die.
*Unlike Protective Spirit, this skill will protect even against small damage packets if there are enough of them. An example would be the large mobs of Avicara Fierce in Mineral Springs who use Ignite Arrows and Dual Shot.
*The effect of this skill isn't triggered by sacrificing health from skills such as Blood is Power.
{{Skill change}}
Unlike most typeless skills with no activation time, this skill cannot be activated in the middle of another action and has a slight aftercast delay.

* Combine Echo and Arcane Echo to create echo chains, allowing you to use three copies of any single skill.
* If the next skill after Arcane Echo is not a spell, this enchantment will end with no effect.
* Arcane Echo will only recharge normally if no spell was copied. If a spell was copied, the copy remains for 20 seconds, after which Arcane Echo is disabled for 20 seconds.
** Consider using Auspicious Incantation before Arcane Echo for energy management, since the recharge time will not be increased.
* If used to copy a spell that can copy another skill or spell, the copy duration of that spell is used and will bypass Arcane Echo's 20-second copy duration.
** E.g., if used to copy Echo, whatever skill that is copied by the Arcane Echo version of Echo will remain as that skill for 30 seconds and then revert back to Arcane Echo.
*Arcane Echo's copying effect triggers first, before the effects of the spell that triggers it. For instance, when used to copy Gift of Health, the copy is disabled by Gift of Health's effect afterwards.
Arcane Echo's description omits the fact that it cannot copy itself.

* This skill creates a Spirit of Recuperation.
* At a glance, a maximum of +3 health regeneration doesn't sound like a lot, but consider that it affects all allies within spirit range. (In regards to party healing, this equates to 17.6 health-to-energy ratio, multiplied by # of allies.) That includes non-party members such as allied NPCs (Master Togo, Mhenlo, etc.), minions, animal companions and, in the case of two-party cooperative missions, members of the other party.
* Combined with Ritual Lord, a level 17 Recuperation will heal 8 health per second, for a maximum 424 health per ally within range throughout its lifespan at rank 19 Restoration Magic and 16 Spawning Power (with Ritual Lord).

rows.source:
* Signet of Illusions has good synergy with spell copying skills (e.g. Inspired Hex or Arcane Thievery), since the copied skills will be used with a high effective rank.
* Spells with a failure chance below a certain attribute rank (such as Slippery Ground) used while under this skill's effect retain their chance to fail.
* Has no duration (this is one of the few skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep).
* No Attribute spells still use charges.
* Although they are not technically linked to attributes, Signet of Illusions will work with spells linked to title tracks.

* Unlike all other skills that "steal" skills, this does not disable the corresponding original and instead is placed as a skill icon in the Effects Monitor. When you hover over the skill icons of elite spells in the Effects Monitor, their skill descriptions will appear to have effects based on their normal ranks, but the Fast Casting rank will be used when the spells are cast.
* Symbols of Inspiration will only recharge normally if no skill was copied. If a skill was copied, Symbols of Inspiration is disabled for 15 seconds after the copy effect ends.
* All elite spells on your skill bar will use your Fast Casting attribute rank even if they were obtained by other means, such as Arcane Mimicry, Arcane Thievery or Signet of Capture. This will work with skills linked to title tracks, specifically Norn Forms.

{{research needed|Which effects do the Norn elite forms remove and which ones do they leave?}}
* When this skill is activated, most effects will be removed, including upkept enchantments, with some exceptions, but Ursan Blessing's effects still override any effects that affect attributes, health, or armor:
** Bundles will still be held, including carried item spell bundles, 
** Summoned creatures will not be dismissed upon having their related skills removed.
** Various skill effects: 
*** Air of Superiority. Its 10% chance to recharge skills on kill may allow early use of Totem of Man and earlier reuse of the Blessing.
*** Protector's Defense
*** Signet of Stamina, but its effect is fully overriden. 
*** Troll Unguent
*** "Together as One!"
*** Never Rampage Alone
* For the first 30 seconds, it's impossible to use Totem of Man as it is recharging.
* When the blessing ends, the skill bar is reverted, and Ursan Blessing starts recharging.
* Since this blessing and all associated skills do not require a weapon to be used, they can be used while carrying bundles.
* Combines well with Item Spells that have an effect when dropped such as Protective Was Kaolai or Blind Was Mingson.
* Combines well with Binding Rituals since spirits will be maintained upon transformation and their attacks are affected by Ursan Roar. 
* Temporary mission skills such as Celestial Storm obtained while in this form will be lost upon leaving this form. They will be returned if they were received before entering this form
Although it is classified as a Form, the caster does not change appearance.
A new skill obtained (as a quest reward) while transformed may be used while in this form. After turning back to human form, the skill stays in the skill bar, but it becomes unusable until its position is swapped with another skill in the skills and attributes panel.

* Self-renewing enchantments (e.g. Lyssa's Aura, Vow of Revolution or Critical Defenses) do not renew this enchantment when they are renewed.
* Vow of Piety triggers Soul Barbs with each reapplication.


When a character is enchanted with Vow of Piety and at least one Air Magic, Earth Magic, Fire Magic or Water Magic enchantment (e.g. Windborne Speed), and loses all enchantments (e.g. due to the effects of Gaze of Contempt, Release Enchantments or Second Wind, but not Rend Enchantments nor Strip Enchantment that remove a certain number of enchantments), Vow of Piety will still be reapplied. This does not occur for Energy Storage, dervish nor monk enchantments. {{{|Video}}}.

anomaly: When a character is enchanted with Vow of Piety and at least one Air Magic, Earth Magic, Fire Magic or Water Magic enchantment (e.g. Windborne Speed), and loses all enchantments (e.g. due to the effects of Gaze of Contempt, Release Enchantments or Second Wind, but not Rend Enchantments nor Strip Enchantment that remove a certain number of enchantments), Vow of Piety will still be reapplied. This does not occur for Energy Storage, dervish nor monk enchantments. {{{|Video}}}.
* The amount of energy regained is rounded; for example, a 5{{energy}} spell returns 3{{energy}} instead of 2.5{{energy}}, and a 15{{energy}} spell returns 6{{energy}} instead of 5.5{{energy}}.

* This skill takes effect as soon as damage is dealt. When triggered by an attack or skill that also applies a condition, that condition will be removed only if it is applied before the damage is dealt.
** Condition-applying attack skills and preparations apply their conditions after the attack damage is dealt; Weapon of Remedy will not remove these conditions.
** Enchantments such as Grenth's Grasp and Double Dragon which add a condition application to subsequent attacks or skills trigger before damage is dealt, allowing Weapon of Remedy to remove their conditions immediately if triggered by the same action.
** Some spells, such as Immolate, deal damage before applying their conditions, whereas others, such as Eruption, apply conditions first. {{research needed|Lots more skills to test, if it's worth doing so. See talk page}}
If used when taking damage from multiple sources from only one attack, Weapon of Remedy will trigger multiple times. For example, if a foe hexed with Barbs takes physical damage, Weapon of Remedy will trigger both for the physical damage and for the Barbs damage.
